ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_delta_rank_logsigmoid_contrastive
ir.intuition: Shift from margin- or ratio-based losses on log probability gaps weighted by advantage_gap, to a contrastive pairwise loss using delta_rank as a quality signal. The loss encourages the model to assign higher probabilities to samples with better ranks by directly using a logsigmoid on the log probability difference normalized by delta_rank, leveraging a contrastive paradigm with explicit penalization of inversions scaled by preference strength. This departs from margin and ratio paradigms, uses delta_rank instead of advantage_gap or cost signals, and adopts a sum aggregation with explicit clipping for stability.
ir.pseudocode:
norm_gap = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(delta_rank) + epsilon)
x = clamp(scale * norm_gap, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x) * weight * abs(delta_rank)
return sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    delta_rank = batch['delta_rank']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    eps = 1e-6
    scale = float(extra.get('scale', 1.0))
    abs_delta_rank = ops.add(ops.abs(delta_rank), eps)
    norm_gap = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), abs_delta_rank)
    x = ops.clamp(ops.mul(scale, norm_gap), -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    weighting = ops.mul(weight if weight is not None else ops.ones_like(loss), ops.abs(delta_rank))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weighting)
    return ops.sum(loss)
